full_judgment: 11. The complainant has alleged many other things in his petition of complaint including that the accused-appellant had assured him of payment of the money on 11-4-96 over telephone and the appellant having failed to keep his word, the complaint was filed on 18-4-96. The subsequent allegations will not save the limitation because, as noticed above, the requirement under the law is that the complaint has to be filed within one month of the date on which the cause of action arises under clause (c) of the proviso to section 138.
